episode_title: 《楚氏春秋》第1集：北赵楚氏·畅春园惊变

shots.scene_summary: Inside the sunlit room of the Pingyuan Prefect's Residence (大赵平原郡太守府) on an early spring morning, Mother Wang Xiuhe on the left gently straightens 6-year-old Chu Zheng's collar and warns him not to climb high places in Changchun Garden, and Chu Zheng on the right smiles and replies playfully about eating candied hawthorns.
shots.camera_motion: smooth, steady medium two-shot with a subtle slow dolly-in
shots.soundscape: Soft early spring morning breeze outside the carved wooden window and gentle silk sleeve movement accompany the clear foreground Mandarin dialogue.

dialogue_1.action: gently smooths the front lapel of <Subject 2>'s sky-blue Hanfu robe while speaking in a warm, affectionate maternal voice
dialogue_1.line: 小五儿，今日初春放晴，跟着你大哥三哥去畅春园玩耍，可不许调皮爬高，知道吗？

dialogue_2.action: looks up at his mother with bright, innocent dark eyes and replies in a crisp, cheerful 6-year-old boy voice
dialogue_2.line: 娘放心吧！小五儿最乖了，让三哥给我买串冰糖葫芦，吃完了就回府陪娘！

shots.scene_summary: In the sunlit royal Changchun Garden (皇家行宫畅春园) with willow trees, a classical pavilion, and a tall Taihu-stone rockery in the background, 13-year-old 3rd Brother <Subject 1> (Chu Yuan) on the left proudly hands a bright red skewer of candied hawthorns (冰糖葫芦) to 6-year-old <Subject 2> (Chu Zheng) on the right and boasts of their father Prefect Chu Mingtang's prestige, while <Subject 2> happily holds his candied hawthorn and points excitedly toward the garden rockery.
shots.camera_motion: smooth cinematic medium two-shot in sunlit Changchun Garden with a gentle slow push-in
shots.soundscape: Cheerful spring birds chirping softly in the royal garden and gentle breeze rustling willow leaves accompany the clear foreground Mandarin dialogue.

dialogue_1.action: hands the bright red candied hawthorn skewer to <Subject 2> on the right and speaks in a proud, protective, spirited teenage brother voice
dialogue_1.line: 小五儿别怕，快吃这串冰糖葫芦！在平原郡地面，有咱爹楚太守在，谁敢招惹咱们楚家！

dialogue_2.action: holds the red candied hawthorn skewer happily, his bright eyes lighting up with excitement as he speaks in a lively, cheerful 6-year-old boy voice
dialogue_2.line: 三哥最好啦！咦，哥哥快看，那假山顶上停着一只翠绿的小鸟，小五儿要去抓它！

shots.scene_summary: At the steep Taihu-stone rockery (太湖石假山) in Changchun Garden under bright sunlight, 6-year-old <Subject 1> (Chu Zheng) perched high on the upper-left rock ledge reaches out for the small green bird, loses his footing in panic, and cries out for help, while 13-year-old <Subject 2> (Chu Yuan) at the lower-right base of the rockery looks up in utter horror, raises his hand, and shouts a frantic warning and call for a physician.
shots.camera_motion: dramatic medium-wide shot framing the steep garden rockery with tense handheld urgency
shots.soundscape: Sudden flutter of bird wings, loose pebbles skittering down the rockery, and urgent outdoor garden ambience accompany the panicked foreground Mandarin speech.

dialogue_1.action: reaches his small hand toward the green bird on the upper-left rock ledge as the bird flutters away, his footing wobbling precariously as he cries out in a startled, frightened 6-year-old boy voice
dialogue_1.line: 小鸟别跑，小五儿马上就抓到你啦……啊！手滑了，哥哥快救我！

dialogue_2.action: at the lower-right base of the rockery lunges forward with wide, horrified eyes and outstretched arm, shouting at the top of his lungs in a frantic, terrified teenage voice
dialogue_2.line: 小五，小心啊！天哪，额头流了这么多血，大哥快抱小五回太守府请郎中！

shots.scene_summary: Inside the solemn Pingyuan Prefectural Government Hall (平原郡太守府衙), sweating retainer <Subject 1> (Li Cheng) kneeling on the left urgently reports that young fifth master Chu Zheng fell from a high rockery and is between life and death, while Prefect <Subject 2> (Chu Mingtang) seated behind the rosewood official desk on the right slams down his calligraphy brush in thunderous fury and commands a horse immediately.
shots.camera_motion: tense cinematic medium two-shot across the rosewood official desk with a sharp push-in toward Prefect Chu Mingtang
shots.soundscape: Quiet official hall room tone, a sharp snap of the calligraphy brush hitting the wooden desk at 00:04.600, and rustling official robes accompany the urgent foreground Mandarin dialogue.

dialogue_1.action: kneeling on the left with clasped hands and pale, sweating face speaks in a breathless, trembling, urgent steward voice
dialogue_1.line: 老爷不好了！老夫人命小人火速传话，五哥儿在畅春园从假山摔下，如今生死不知！

dialogue_2.action: on the right slams his calligraphy brush down onto the memorial scroll with an iron-grim face and roars in a thunderous, commanding, furious baritone voice
dialogue_2.line: 什么？！小五儿若有半点闪失，我定不轻饶！备什么轿，立刻给本官备马回府！

shots.scene_summary: Inside the warm candlelit bedroom of the Chu Mansion at night, beside 6-year-old Chu Zheng who lies unconscious under a silk quilt with a clean white bandage around his forehead, Mother <Subject 1> (Wang Xiuhe) seated at the left bedside holds her son's small hand and weeps softly in maternal heartbreak, while Father <Subject 2> (Chu Mingtang) standing beside her comforts her in a deep, resolute voice that former Imperial Physician Cai Jue will save their son.
shots.camera_motion: emotional slow dolly-in medium shot by the candlelit carved canopy bed
shots.soundscape: Quiet night bedroom ambience with soft candle flame flicker and gentle silk rustle accompany the emotional foreground Mandarin dialogue.

dialogue_1.action: seated at the bedside holding injured young Chu Zheng's small hand with both of hers, her eyes glistening with tears, speaks in a choked, sorrowful, loving maternal voice
dialogue_1.line: 我的小五儿啊……额头摔得这么重，你可千万要快些醒过来，别吓娘亲啊……

dialogue_2.action: standing beside Wang Xiuhe gazes down at his unconscious son on the bed and speaks in a deep, steady, reassuring paternal baritone voice
dialogue_2.line: 夫人莫急，蔡珏先生曾是宫中大内御医，我已留他在府中施针，铮儿定能转危为安！
